algorithm: For each condition trajectory y, compare p_U(.|I,Q,U,y[:k]) with p_0(.|I,Q,y[:k]), k=0..T-1. No independent neutral generation.
entropy: full vocabulary native logits, before sampling filters, nats
primary_analysis: ordinary thinking tokens after output step64; keep opening separate
secondary_analysis: First64 opening reported separately. Semantic opening is not automatically annotated; fixed64 cutoff must not be represented as exact sentence segmentation.
cohorts: each model existing judgments: neutral correct->wrong,neutral correct->correct,neutral wrong,unresolved; no filtering on right-claim outcome
group_weighting: question-level means; datasets/models reported separately; PathVQA repeated images not independent image samples
runtime: multi-GPU sharding only; original per-model config; device_map/max_memory placement may be set explicitly and recorded; no numerical/sampling/prompt/image/model changes; natural process exit
replay_implementation: Native whole-sequence teacher forcing with sampled prefix checks; reject numerically failing records and recompute both branches with exact native single-token caching, retaining original gates and saved diagnostics.
